# Newsletter email template: media layout

**Scope:** the sent newsletter email, generated by `builder/js/template.js`. This
is the ERC's outward maroon design (Trebuchet MS, `#500000`, nested-table
layout). It is NOT the Content Desk's UI: no desk tokens, fonts or components
here.

Items in research, spotlight, events and opportunities can carry a picture
(`fields.image`). It renders as a "stamp" beside the item text. The code is
`STAMP` and the item builders in `builder/js/template.js`; the tests are the
"Item media: the stamp" block in `builder/tests/template.test.js`.

## Rules

- **Picture under the title.** The title spans the column; the picture sits
  below it, left of the authors/meta line and the blurb, in a two-cell row.
- **Never cropped.** The same portrait image the desk saved; the template only
  sizes it.
- **Sized from the text beside it.** `textHeight()` estimates that text's height
  (lines × line-height + margins at the narrowest column a stamp can leave);
  width = height ÷ 1.25 (a 4:5 portrait photo is the tallest shape assumed),
  capped at 96px; under 40px the picture is dropped. So a stamp never stands
  taller than the words next to it.
- **No picture without a blurb.** An item that is only a title and a date line
  shows none, even if one was uploaded.
- **EdTalk headshots sit beside the title.** For items whose title says "EdTalk"
  (spotlight and events), the title moves into the text cell, so the picture
  stands beside title, date line and blurb, capped at 160px (a 4:5 headshot
  renders 160 x 200). Still sized from the text beside it, still nothing without
  a blurb.
- **No border on any stamp.** The picture cell is the picture plus a 14px
  gutter.
- **The stamp is the link.** It opens the full-size image (`target="_blank"
  rel="noopener"`) with no link text. Alt reads `Picture: {title}`: pictures are
  photos, not flyers.
- **Markup:** a two-cell `role="presentation"` table inside the item's existing
  `<td>`, image cell first and `valign="top"`, a `width` attribute plus the
  inline width, `display:block`. Nested tables, inline styles, Outlook-safe. The
  gutter lives in the cell width only, so Word and the browsers agree on the box.
- **Scheme-guarded `src`.** The URL is a raw.githubusercontent link.
- **No image, no wrapper.** The item renders exactly as it did before stamps.
- **Edit hooks.** `data-edit-*` for the `image` field stay on the `<img>` in
  editable renders; exports stay hook-free.
- **Sheet width 640px.** Item text ends 48px from the right; item dividers 12px
  each side; a later group label sits 32px below the last item.

## The headshot file

4:5 portrait, 640 x 800 recommended (320 x 400 minimum), JPG or PNG under
2.5 MB, face large in the frame, transparent background allowed.

## Rejected

So nobody re-litigates them: zigzag left/right stamps; the 36px small stamp;
full width below (the original treatment); thumbnail right at 218px; banner
above; framed inset with a caption; float wrap, per item and across a group;
"View flyer" link text; square crops; a capped poster below the text; a
bulletin-board section; a landscape strip; justified and hyphenated text beside
a right-hand stamp; the 1px `#e6e2dd` hairline with its 3px radius.

## Still open

The email band prints `"ERC Research"` (hard-coded, `builder/js/template.js:191`)
while the builder's Outline calls the same section "Featured Research". One
should change; the email's name is the one subscribers read.
